notes.title: 🐾 No Slack Pets Demo & Playtest FAQ + Test Rewards!
notes.notes: [h3]    Thank you very much to every player who participated in the test. It is your recognition that gives us the motivation to keep improving the game. Now the Demo version has been made available for free. There are some questions that get asked frequently, so this time we’ll share both the perks and FAQ with everyone all at once. Wishing you all a wonderful time playing the game!🐱[/h3][p][/p][h1]1️⃣ Versions[/h1][h3]Q: What’s the difference between Demo and Playtest? [/h3][p]A:[/p][list][*][p]Demo = stable core gameplay, fewer features, free for everyone to try.[/p][/*][*][p]Playtest = test new features, may have more bugs, feedback is welcome! Approved Playtesters can also invite 2 friends to join.[/p][/*][/list][p]﻿[/p][hr][/hr][p]﻿[/p][h3]Q: What’s the difference between Demo and Full release? [/h3][p]A:[/p][list][*][p]Demo doesn’t include synthesis, ranking, or some customization.[/p][/*][*][p]Full version will have more modes, mini-games, to-do list, and 800+ items. (Demo currently has about 150+ headwear + decorations.)[/p][/*][/list][p]﻿[/p][hr][/hr][p]﻿[/p][h3]Q: How do I download the Demo? [/h3][p]A: Option 1: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3714370"] Main store page [/url] → click Download Demo. [/p][p]Option 2: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3738680"] Demo store page [/url] → click Install Demo.[/p][p]﻿[/p][hr][/hr][p]﻿[/p][h1]2️⃣ Save Data[/h1][h3]Q: Will my progress carry over to the full release? [/h3][p]A: [/p][p]✅ Paw Coin, purchased items, achievements, levels, playtime → will carry over. [/p][p]❌ Headgears from test versions → won’t carry over (technical reason with Steam inventory).[/p][p]﻿[/p][hr][/hr][p]﻿[/p][h1]3️⃣ In-game FAQ[/h1][h3]Q: What if I get an error when opening a gift box? [/h3][p]A: It’s usually a connection issue with Steam services. Wait 1 minute and try again. If the issue continues, check your Steam connection or try a VPN.[/p][p]﻿[/p][hr][/hr][p]﻿[/p][h3]Q: How to earn Paw Coin?[/h3][p] A: Through piggy bank (auto every minute), daily tasks, Miino greetings, leveling up, mini-games, and achievements.[/p][p]﻿[/p][hr][/hr][p]﻿[/p][h3]Q: How to earn EXP? [/h3][p]A: Also through piggy bank, daily tasks, Miino greetings, and mini-games.[/p][p]﻿[/p][hr][/hr][p]﻿[/p][h3]Q: How to get headgear? [/h3][p]A: Every 30 min you’ll receive a gift box 🎁 with a random headgear.
